$:set -euo pipefail
CODESPACE=shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96
printf 'Stopping %s\n' "$CODESPACE"
gh api --method POST "user/codespaces/${CODESPACE}/stop" >/dev/null
printf 'Starting %s\n' "$CODESPACE"
gh api --method POST "user/codespaces/${CODESPACE}/start" >/dev/null
printf 'Current status:\n'
gh api "user/codespaces/${CODESPACE}" --jq '{name: .name, state: .state}'
